evidence.excerpt: Current two-page $45/$55 prix-fixe and à-la-carte dinner menu for Dinner Tues-Sunday at 606 N Fayette St; item descriptions, GF/GFA/CN legend, and restaurant-level cross-contamination advisory.
Linked Toast exact-location catalog at 606 N Fayette St lists 21 Dinner a la carte products and seven Kids Menu products, including Baguette & Butter and Seasonal Vegetables.
L’Apero @ Bastille Happy Hour, Menu Valid 06/04/2026, lists Bouchées plus Athletic Brewing non-alcoholic beer; alcohol and spirit-list rows are excluded.
Les Desserts, Menu Valid 05/22/2026, itemizes nine desserts plus brewed coffee, espresso, cappuccino, latte and hot tea; dessert/fortified wines are excluded.
Petit Gourmands lists six food/sides, six nonalcoholic drinks and two desserts; Burger Add On and Ask your server for flavors are modifiers/instructions, not products.
Current beverage PDF dated 06/26/2026 lists Free Spirited drinks, sodas, and Athletic Brewing NA Golden Lager/NA IPA; alcoholic cocktails, wine, cider, beer and spirits are excluded.
JUILLET-JULY Plat du Mois lists Daurade à la Marocaine and Gâteau Marocain with full display descriptions and 606 N Fayette identity inherited from the official dinner page link.
Official homepage identifies Bastille Brasserie & Bar at 606 N. Fayette St, Alexandria, VA 22314 and links the exact-location menu pages and Toast ordering.
Dinner Tuesday-Sunday, 4:00PM-9:00PM; links DINNER A LA CARTE & PRIX FIXE PDF, PDF PLAT DU MOIS, and Bar & Happy Hour Menu; warns that not all ingredients are listed.
